_comment: OpenRouter-routed Anthropic response — cache-WRITE turn (cold start). OpenRouter surfaces writes under prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens; reads (when present) live in prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (OpenAI-canonical singular). On a write-only turn cached_tokens is 0. On a hit-only turn cache_write_tokens is 0 and cached_tokens carries the read count — see openrouter_anthropic_usage_real.json for that case.
